reports.title: Expert-major MoE window capacity and 81,920-row reachability
corrections: R1014-C1: Spec's 401,674,240-byte full-cap mixed-bank arithmetic is actually 78,452 rows; full 81,920 is 419,430,400 bytes. Report corrected this and preserves the 78,453 actual versus 78,452 batched distinction.
R1014-C2: A capacity-derived maximum must not be rounded down to a full 8,192 multiple if one window must cover 78,452 device rows; distinguish maximum cap, actual rows and final partial piece.

R1014-C3: Recompute each partial-window arena using every plane's round_up(payload,256)+256 reservation. Formula gives 1,022,996,480 bytes at 78,452 rows, 1,023,006,720 at 78,453, and 1,059,131,904 at 81,920; none proves physical fit.

R1014-C4: R1012 review correction applies: current mode-2 fallback is for VRAM/headroom admission rejection only. Shared-region planning or later mixed allocation errors fail; they do not retry mode 2.
R1014-C5: Full 400 MiB reservation is a policy choice, not implied by an 81,920 maximum; current admission sizes count=min(cap,gpu_rows). State the bank reservation policy explicitly.
reports.scope_depth_review: Strong source reachability audit across admission, route factory, operator entrypoint, plan/views, host metadata, async lifetime, callbacks and physical-context tail; supplies an implementation checklist without claiming fit or speed.
reports.redundancy_review: Updates the indexed 65,536-row expert-major/accumulator hypothesis and window-route work, including R1011 (b04cb51468b3437528cf1ecc9da70eb206b9270afc58fae08dd7e322a153eeb1) and its R1012 review (f36ded666245ae7c245c4694474e46009248301979bdf69313ecf04d07c6c2be). It adds independent row ceilings and later callback/tail obligations.
